description: Display ad-unit funnel for a marketplace over a period: requests, non-zero responses, response rate, impressions, clicks, marketplace-currency spend and revenue, and the program funnel events (view-product, add-to-cart, conversions). Group by ad_unit_name and/or page_type for the ad-unit and page-type breakdowns, or by date for the daily request / response trend used in budget-utilisation debugging. Pass a page_type NOT IN ('', 'NA') filter to reproduce the guard the retired page-type and daily-requests reports hardcoded.

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN auf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN auf.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN auf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN auf.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END), 0)

response_rate.selector: ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN auf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN auf.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END) * 100, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN auf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN auf.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)), 2)

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN auf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN auf.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN auf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN auf.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN auf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN auf.cost ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Ad spend on this ad unit, converted to the marketplace currency.

revenue.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN auf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN auf.program_per_click_timestamp_sales ELSE 0 END), 0)
revenue.description: Attributed sales (per-click-timestamp) for this ad unit, converted to the marketplace currency. Python divides by spend for ROI.

view_product.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN auf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN auf.program_per_click_timestamp_viewproduct ELSE 0 END), 0)

add_to_cart.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN auf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN auf.program_per_click_timestamp_add_to_cart ELSE 0 END), 0)

conversions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN auf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN auf.program_per_click_timestamp_conversions ELSE 0 END), 0)

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting.os_display_ads_ad_unit_facts AS auf INNER JOIN reporting.clients AS mc ON auf.marketplace_client_id = mc.client_id LEFT JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc ON scc.from_currency = 'USD' AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND auf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
